fusions.name: Firm Grasp
fusions.desc: Throws a stinger that deals 8 damage, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of the original damage. Each hit has a 35% chance of [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds. Holds up to 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Shared Burden
fusions.desc: A shove of many hands deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Steadying Touch
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from an ally and restores 10 health to them. Fighting beside others pays: +11% per ally within 5.5 tiles, capped at 4.

fusions.name: Many Fingers
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar of force that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage. Anything it strikes moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
